cases.description: Synthetic Netsh command adds an IPv4 PortProxy rule.
Synthetic uppercase Netsh command adds a PortProxy rule with bounded context.
Synthetic renamed Netsh binary retains its original filename and adds a PortProxy rule.
Synthetic PortProxy display command does not add a rule.
Synthetic PortProxy deletion does not add a rule.
Synthetic Netsh firewall rule creation is outside PortProxy scope.
